theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_te_l1d_smooth_sign_sep
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K₁ K₂ : Set (Eucl n)), IsCompact K₁ → IsCompact K₂ → Disjoint K₁ K₂ → ∃ g : Eucl n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ (∀ x, |g x| ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K₁, g x = 1) ∧ (∀ x ∈ K₂, g x = -1)
